# discord_server_widget (Resource)

Manages the widget settings for a Discord server.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the widget is enabled.
- `server_id` (String) The server (guild) ID.

### Optional

- `channel_id` (String) The channel ID for the widget invite.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as server_id.
